Fixes found by a full uninstall and reinstall test.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.7.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Fixes

- **Clearing the settings folder no longer cuts off running bots.** The key bots use to reach the app's This PC and group tools used to live only in `%APPDATA%\NexurBots`. Clear that folder and the app made a new key, while Hermes processes already running (a bot's Discord gateway, say) kept the old one, so their tool calls were refused every few minutes until they restarted. The app now also keeps the key, encrypted for your Windows account, in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NexurBots`, and uses it again.
- **The one-command install finds the app wherever it was installed**, including a custom folder, by reading where the uninstaller is.
- **The one-command install doesn't stop when it can't ask** "this PC or VPS" (a non-interactive PowerShell); it sets up on this PC.
- Its last line no longer tells you to pick "This computer" when the app has already connected to your saved machine.
